name: Pink Salad Dressing
notes: A sweet dressing, fabulous on greens with cranberries, Granny Smith apples, bacon, and sugared nuts!

steps.title: Blend the dressing
steps.body: Mix in blender: **½ cup red onion**, **2 tsp dry mustard**, **1 cup sugar**, **¼ cup cider vinegar**, **1½ tsp salt**, **¼ cup red wine vinegar** and **1 cup canola oil**.
